acceptanceCriteria: Active lifecycle rejects foreign Runtime evidence.
Archived historical evidence is explicitly projected as historical and remains integrity-bound.
Close after Runtime upgrade requires current resource finalization receipt but does not require historical evidence to match current Runtime.
Finalization documentation describes the Runtime-vs-historical evidence boundary in all three languages.
Regression tests cover active rejection and archived close compatibility.
goal: Preserve immutable evidence and prevent Runtime-version changes from leaving merged Work Items permanently uncloseable.
intent: Allow archived Work Items to close after Runtime upgrades without revalidating historical verification bytes, while keeping active Work Items strictly bound to the executing Runtime.
outOfScope: Rewriting archived evidence bytes or weakening active Work Item Runtime binding.
Provider cleanup automation or global Agent/MCP configuration.
